summary: Concord Medical Services Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing auditor resignation and replacement plus planned restatement, an accounting/control event rather than a deal. Shandong Haoxin resigned September 14, 2026; Guangdong Prouden was engaged September 22, 2026 with audit committee approval. The company will restate fiscal 2024 and 2025 financials after SEC Staff comments (August 27, 2026) indicated it lost controlling financial interest in Concord Healthcare Group when its voting interest fell below a majority. Watch delisting, Nasdaq compliance, and going-concern risk from the restatement.
